To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the design, implementation and evaluation of a group management service for MANET is a viable and effective approach toward realization of pervasive applications over MANET.
group management can be implemented as a generic service over MANET, and that it can be applied for scalable service discovery in mobile ad hoc networks.

the group management service is designed to support the various attributes of interest, such as group membership management, group communication support, and service discovery support, that it is implemented as a middleware service over MANET and that its support for service discovery is demonstrated with the use of an application.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and implementation issues of generic group management for MANET and the evaluation of its performance.
the development of a generic group management service for MANET.
the design of generic group management for MANET, and its support of scalable, distributed service discovery in MANETS.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
group management can be a powerful paradigm to support the development of applications for MANET, but it is not a panacea.
the group management service for MANET is feasible to be realized, and it has the potential to facilitate application development over such networks.
the group management paradigm is an effective approach toward the realization of pervasive computing in MANET.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have successfully designed, implemented and experimentally evaluated a generic group management scheme for MANET.
the generic group management service can be easily integrated with any application to provide the necessary group management functionality.

the group management service provides a convenient basis toward the realization of distributed applications in MANET, by providing a generic, extensible framework to meet the various requirements of applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a well-designed group management service can be a key enabler of distributed applications for MANET.
a generic group service can serve as an enabler of distributed applications over MANET, while providing a convenient basis toward development of higher-level group services.
a generic group management framework is a promising approach to address the challenges posed by the network dynamics of MANET.
